rules.anchor: Lens does NOT replace correctness review
rules.why: the code-reviewer agent owns correctness; the lens audits structure only

rules.anchor: Also does NOT duplicate the mechanical validators
rules.why: the caller's validator gate owns mechanical checks

rules.anchor: hexagonal layer purity intentionally absent
rules.why: the architecture validator already enforces layer boundaries

rules.anchor: Apply fixes BEFORE human reviewer see it.
rules.why: the lens is a pre-flight: the author fixes first

rules.anchor: Before `git commit` on a non-trivial change (>1 file or >20 LOC)
rules.why: a non-trivial commit gets the full pass

rules.anchor: Before `git push` on a feature branch with a PR
rules.why: a push gets the full pass

rules.anchor: Lenses A + G
rules.why: a new domain type or port gets cohesion and type-system lenses

rules.anchor: Lenses C + D + E
rules.why: a new test gets the three test lenses

rules.anchor: Adding a lookup table / map / registry
rules.why: a new lookup table gets the table-vs-inline lens

rules.anchor: Writing an ADR or design doc
rules.why: an ADR gets the framing lens

rules.anchor: H only for an ADR or design doc
rules.why: lens H never runs on a code diff

rules.anchor: Supply it whenever the change is already committed.
rules.why: a committed change has no staged diff to read

rules.anchor: in the order given, which the caller supplies as merge order
rules.why: the file reads in merge order

rules.anchor: judge the file by its combined final state, not each patch alone
rules.why: duplication added then removed is not a finding

rules.anchor: **run relevant lenses in order**
rules.why: lenses run in the stated order

rules.anchor: Lens H run against ADR/design doc
rules.why: lens H reads the document, not the diff

rules.anchor: `git diff --staged` when preparing commit
rules.why: the staged diff is the subject of a pre-commit audit

rules.anchor: propose structural alternative (don't just complain)
rules.why: a smell comes with a structural alternative

rules.anchor: Apply fixes that are clear wins.
rules.why: clear wins are applied, not only listed

rules.anchor: If fix invasive, document rationale and get second opinion.
rules.why: an invasive fix is not applied alone

rules.anchor: Surface judgment calls to user.
rules.why: the user decides judgment calls

rules.anchor: Report at end with table in **Output format**
rules.why: the report ends the pass in the stated table

rules.anchor: **not** against `git diff`
rules.why: lens H input is a document

rules.anchor: `/spec` encounters open decision at its step 6
rules.why: the spec flow calls lens H for an open decision

rules.anchor: inline at call sites. Don't keep table for
rules.why: a table with few rows is inlined, not kept for future entries

rules.anchor: Controller integration: ONLY wiring-on-one-representative
rules.why: controller specs test wiring only

rules.anchor: No Nest boot.
rules.why: validator behaviour is tested in a unit spec without booting the framework

rules.anchor: don't write two positive tests on them; write one.
rules.why: inputs the system cannot tell apart get one test

rules.anchor: Replace reference with project's own term
rules.why: test titles use project vocabulary

rules.anchor: RFC/spec references ARE acceptable in
rules.why: references stay in decision documents

rules.anchor: Drop dead variant.
rules.why: an unemitted variant is removed

rules.anchor: "Future-proofing" recommendation is textbook signal
rules.why: future-proofing is a reason to apply YAGNI harder

rules.anchor: Class extension instead of `as unknown as` cast for test stubs.
rules.why: test stubs avoid double casts

rules.anchor: Restate problem one level deeper.
rules.why: the framing goes one level deeper

rules.anchor: Lead doc with deeper framing
rules.why: the document opens with the deeper question

rules.anchor: | H. Framing depth | CLEAN \| N/A (no ADR in scope)
rules.why: lens H reports N/A when no ADR is in scope

rules.anchor: <issue + 2 alternatives>
rules.why: a surfaced issue offers two alternatives

rules.anchor: READY-TO-COMMIT / REVISE-FIRST
rules.why: the verdict is one of two fixed tokens

rules.anchor: emit the chosen token alone on its own line
rules.why: a check can read the verdict

rules.anchor: Verdict token goes on own line, by itself.
rules.why: a check can read the verdict

rules.anchor: **Don't over-trigger.**
rules.why: a one-line fix does not need every lens

rules.anchor: **Cite lens by letter** (A–H)
rules.why: findings map back to the checklist

rules.anchor: **Cross-reference sibling-service precedents when available**
rules.why: precedent validates the structural call

rules.anchor: Format: `<file:line> — <smell> — <structural alternative>`
rules.why: one fixed finding format

rules.anchor: If right move is "drop X", say "drop X"
rules.why: directness over hedging

exempt.anchor: Parametrized fixture row whose value never appears
exempt.reason: checklist example of a smell to look for, not an instruction to the model

exempt.anchor: Union variant declared in type but never emitted
exempt.reason: checklist example of a smell to look for, not an instruction to the model

exempt.anchor: `case X: ... default: throw` where X never the value
exempt.reason: checklist example of a smell to look for, not an instruction to the model
